name: Mamiya Aoi
source:
Born in Otaru and raised in Sapporo. He grew up in Otaru until elementary school ended, and moved to Sapporo for junior high school. After graduating from a public high school, he disappeared for a while (he worked and did various things). He finally succeeded in opening his own bar half a year ago. His bar doubles as a home and is called "Mar'S."

The bar's recommendation is a cocktail called "Yume Utsutsu," which is said to make the color look different depending on who is looking at it. Currently, he is also focusing on researching side dishes that go well with sake and what customers might like. However, he has no aesthetic sense.

[Translated from [url=https://saya-sp.com/hanasaya_gp_op/layer_if/layer_ifb_character/]official website[/url]]
